design_acceptance.implementation_authority: granted inside the unchanged sealed mutation fence

HSF-1.rule: operator-supplied currently advertised input/output rates with recorded source, observation time, route and the accepted fixed conservative upper-bound basis

HSF-3.rule: explicit campaign/run path or run ID

HSF-4.rule: add RunState.CANCELLED for explicit operator cancellation; stage-level cancellation uses error_type="cancelled"
HSF-4.sibling: retains its own cancelled cause rather than inheriting the run failure
HSF-4.hard_kill: durable cancelled_pending remains interrupted/uncertain, never success, never automatically retried

HSF-5.note: explicit model changes do not authorize provider-route switching

errata.O-1: a non-dispatched terminal synthesis is classified NOT_APPLICABLE before the staleness predicate is evaluated; update task-facing wording accordingly
errata.O-2: validation must explicitly prove that a sibling cancelled during generic run failure has error_type == "cancelled" while the run remains FAILED with internal_error
errata.O-3: the stage-level cancellation label is cancelled; HSF-4 changes the run-level state only
errata.O-4: standardize the new serialized field name as api_key_source
errata.status: accepted as non-blocking design errata; mechanical task-facing clarifications only

budget.fourth_launch_reserved_for: fresh final implementation oracle against the final frozen/resealed implementation candidate

stop_rule: if a concrete defect is fixable inside the accepted fence, fix it; if the fence itself, accepted product semantics, dependency boundary, or one of these adjudications must change, STOP FOR MICK
